problem: What is the smallest currentness projection sufficient for immediate consequential-action safety under a set of admissible institutional bindings?
bindingSet: All unique current binding cores across admissible linearizations of a partial-order batch.
safeRule: ALLOW iff status set == {AUTHORIZED}, office-holder set is singleton, controller set is the same singleton; otherwise HOLD.
candidateLaws: safe actions under uncertainty are monotone under information refinement: if ALLOW over a binding set, every nonempty subset is also ALLOW
consequence envelope is a coarser quotient than binding set but sufficient for the frozen immediate-action rule
guards: ConsequenceEnvelope is derived and owns no source truth.
Immediate-action sufficiency does not imply future transition sufficiency.
Synthetic generator frequencies are not real-world prevalence.
